reference.headline: JetBlue Raises Checked Bag Fees to $50
reference.summary: JetBlue has raised its checked baggage fees to a minimum of $50, marking a 43% increase since May 2024.
key_points: First checked bag fees start at $50 for off-peak periods when prepaid.
Transatlantic passengers face first bag fees starting at $80 off-peak.
JetBlue cited the rising cost of jet fuel for the fee increases.
Certain cardholders, elite members, and cabin classes remain exempt.

key_points: Donald Trump blamed Fox News for GOP midterm losses and declining ratings.

candidates.headline: Flutter Reports $1.15B Loss and Slashes Guidance
candidates.summary: Flutter posts a huge net loss and lowers its guidance after facing setbacks in Brazil and weaker EBITDA.
key_points: Flutter reported a net loss of $1.15 billion, including an $873 million impairment from Brazil.
FanDuel's EBITDA dropped 94% to $3 million as promotional spend increased.
The company cut its 2026 full-year adjusted EBITDA guidance by $160 million.
Average monthly players on FanDuel's U.S. sportsbook rose 9% in the third quarter.

candidates.headline: CVS Health is splitting into two separate companies
candidates.summary: CVS Health is breaking up its retail pharmacies and Aetna insurance business into two distinct companies.
key_points: CVS Health announced it will split into two separate companies.
The move separates retail pharmacies from the Aetna insurance and benefit operations.
Following the news, CVS shares plunged 12.6% to $79.94.
Prem Shah will lead CVS Pharmacy and David Joyner will lead the second company.

candidates.headline: Shipping Costs Are Surging This Holiday Season
candidates.summary: Global air cargo and parcel shipping rates have spiked significantly, threatening holiday profits.
key_points: Air cargo rates are up 43% globally to about $3.37 per kilogram.
Retailers face a 16% jump in parcel shipping rates compared to last year.
Fuel surcharges currently make up about 30% of the transportation rate.
UPS, FedEx, and USPS have added holiday surcharges through season end.
